review_type: independent screenshot-led review after multi-viewport QA
strengths: The inspect verb governs composition, copy, state change, and the poster aperture rather than relying on scroll spectacle.
Five editions form a keyboard-operable editorial instrument with state communicated by text, structure, and aria-selected.
The mobile tab rail, object-first order, and reduced-motion behavior feel authored rather than mechanically compressed.
remaining_limits: The object and history are explicitly fictional and do not test comprehension with a real archive audience.
Compact folio labels warrant native-device review despite passing automated contrast and overflow checks.
Field Core Web Vitals remain unmeasured.

adapt: oversized serif typography is paired with dense provenance rather than vague marketing copy
replace: generic gallery grid replaced by one inspectable object sequence
remove: decorative parallax and repeated reveal animations
